report:
Fresh complete followup assessment of test_source. Saved and read prior report/inputs before start, recaptured all five dependencies, and compared every current fragment. The sole delta is the added placeholder_status association comment immediately before test inventory construction in review.rs. Claim, three tests, correspondence span/cfg extraction, status helper, fixture and design policy are unchanged. No input representation behavior changed.

The complete claim requires the whole annotated test function (attributes/signature/body/contained comments), crate/target/Rust path/file/inherited cfg/status metadata, and exclusion of source coordinates. The sole ordinary implementation association owns the inventory conversion: it slices the original function span, preserves text through source_lines, constructs a semantic Selector::Test fragment keyed by source path/crate/target/Rust path, copies all required metadata to ReviewTest and classifies status from the owner. Neither ReviewTest nor Selector::Test stores line/byte positions; extraction spans remain internal. Missing source and ambiguous identities fail rather than yielding truncated input. Captured correspondence helpers supply complete item spans, accumulated module and function cfg, and byte conversion to original source. Captured placeholder_status preserves TODO/N/A module ancestry and otherwise Ordinary. The new comment connects this existing behavior to another claim without changing it.

All three ordinary test bodies were read fully. test_selector_preserves_metadata_and_ignores_unrelated_line_movement directly asserts every identity field, inherited test/unix cfg and Ordinary status; exact TEST equality includes attributes, signature, contained comment and assertion. Approval survives unrelated preceding text but fails after cfg changes, exposing coordinate leakage or metadata omission. inline_test_capture_preserves_intent_and_excludes_macro_implementation requires exact equality with the full annotated function including macro input, options, expectation and diagnostic markers. It excludes the external macro definition, preserves validity after changing only that definition and invalidates after each changed severity/compiler qualifier inside the function. accepted_placeholder_reports_preserve_todo_and_na_evidence checks both placeholder statuses explicitly, retains rationale and verifies that an accepted report counts deferred/N/A evidence rather than ordinary approved behavior. These fixture placeholders are substantive tests of classification, not deferred evidence for this claim.

The recaptured fixture constructs real source files and calls production APIs; assertion details remain in the annotated bodies. There are no TODO/N/A implementation or test associations for this anchor and no deferred requirement. The one marker-only delta was assessed against the complete prior accounting, with all other relied-on inputs verified unchanged. No source changes or test-suite reruns occurred; this review performed fresh start/read/record and source inspection, while central execution is reported separately. No requested edits.
